title: Own the operator surfaces tk dropped without replacement: factory webhook, herdr paint/notify
description:
Routed upstream from the ticks pwp deletion epic (final review sx5, attempt 9), checked against ticfac's actual CLI.

Covered already: factory deploy/setup/status/dashboard, the cloud run|stop|status|logs|trace|supervisor slice, and run-epic's wave loop.

NOT covered, and deleted from tk with no replacement:
- tk factory webhook (register/inspect/withdraw the factory's Telegram webhook) — no ticfac command, no setup rung.
- herdr pane badges and blocked/settled chimes. Nothing in ticfac calls PaneReportMetadata or NotificationShow, so what tk herd paint and tk herd notify provided is gone. The still-shipped herdr-ticks plugin expects them.
- tk herd guard and tk herd plugin have no equivalent either.

The wire methods already exist in ticfac's client (internal/herd/client/methods.go:597,734). What is missing is callers and commands, not protocol work.

Decide per surface whether ticfac owns it or it is deliberately dropped, and record the dropped ones so the ticks-side plugin tick (si0) can act on a settled answer.
